verdict.rationale: Swell's own docs say developers can build storefront frontends with any framework, and its CLI covers creating storefronts. It also ships a first-party storefront app, Proxima, with Liquid/Shopify-compatible themes, but that is theme-based rather than a fully custom headless framework. The pack documents only the backend API (with Node and PHP libraries); no dedicated storefront/frontend API reference appears, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec. Missing for 10: documented storefront API reference, first-party headless frontend framework or SDK, published API spec, independent hands-on corroboration of a custom headless build.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a fully custom headless storefront on a documented storefront API or first-party frontend framework

citations.quote: Build frontends for storefronts and admin workflows with any framework.
Swell CLI is a command-line interface that helps you create and work with apps, themes, and storefronts.
Proxima is Swell's first official storefront app intended to help merchants get started quickly
Official libraries for the Swell API are available for Node and PHP.
